routes.name: Flattop Gully
routes.approach: Leave Bear Lake on the Flattop trail, bound for Lake Helene. Shortly before the main path bends right toward Odessa Lake, a faint climbers' path on the left drops through the trees to the lake. Continue above the lake to the tarn below Notchtop. routes.descent: The gully is tight and winding and ends at the summit of Flattop Mountain. From there either hike the Flattop trail back to Bear Lake or glissade the Ptarmigan snowfields and walk out the way you came. Any short rock steps partway up are easily scram

routes.name: Northeast Gully
routes.approach: Leave Bear Lake on the Flattop trail, bound for Lake Helene. Just before the main path bends right toward Odessa Lake, a faint climbers' path on the left leads down through the trees to the lake. The gully starts from the south side of the lake and is the farthest left of the snow climbs on Flattop. These are steep snow slopes in avalanche terrain, so check the avalanche forecast first.
routes.descent: The gully runs between two rock buttresses near the top and ends on the summit of Flattop Mountain, with some easy mixed scrambling possible between snowfields. Descend by the Flattop trail back toward Bear Lake. Carry an axe and crampons for the sno
